content.text:
=== elasticsearch.yml ===
cluster.name: index-data-explorer
node.name: node-1
path.data: /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/data
path.logs: /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/logs
network.host: 127.0.0.1
http.port: 9200
discovery.type: single-node
http.cors.enabled: true
http.cors.allow-origin: "http://localhost"
http.cors.allow-headers: "Authorization,X-Requested-With,Content-Type,Content-Length,X-Elastic-Client-Meta"
http.cors.max-age: 1728000

=== ES version ===
7.17.28

=== pidfiles ===
-rw-rw-r-- 1 elastic  elastic  5 Oct 18 11:46 /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/elasticsearch.pid
srw-rw---- 1 www-data www-data 0 Oct 18 11:43 /run/php/php8.1-fpm.sock

observation.command: echo "=== elasticsearch.yml ==="; grep -vE "^\s*#|^\s*$" /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/config/elasticsearch.yml; echo; echo "=== ES version ==="; curl -s http://localhost:9200/ | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['version']['number'])"; echo; echo "=== pidfiles ==="; ls -la /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/elasticsearch.pid /run/php/php8.1-fpm.sock 2>&1
